note: reconcile_destination_job_failure(job_id, payload, error, will_retry) at the frozen clock 2026-08-29T10:40:00Z. message = str(error or 'destination sync attempt failed')[:1000]. Terminal runs (completed, completed_with_errors, failed, cancelled) and unknown runs: nothing. cancelling: _finish_cancelled (pending/in_flight deliveries -> cancelled 'Run cancelled before delivery', counters from the ledger, run cancelled 'Cancellation completed', last_success_at when any succeeded). retry: run pending, error 'Queue retry scheduled: <msg>', finished_at NULL, in_flight deliveries -> pending with that error. final: run failed 'Final failure: <msg>' (may exceed 1000 chars by the prefix), pending/in_flight deliveries -> failed with that error, counters recomputed (attempted = attempts>0), destination degraded with last_error = run.error. Payload ids are strip()-ed; empty ones raise ValueError.
